summary: This directory provides utilities for normalizing and converting various input types, such as file paths and buffers, into a unified Readable stream format or target buffers for stream-based data processing.
responsibilities: Normalize diverse input sources into a standardized stream format
Convert readable streams into buffered data structures
Bridge file system paths and in-memory data representations
relationships: Input types are converted into readable streams to provide a uniform data source for processing.
Readable streams are transformed into buffers or array buffers to satisfy specific memory-based data requirements.
designDecisions: Use of function overloading to handle polymorphic input types
Abstraction of data sources through a unified input union type
